transform: Per-image, per-channel 2nd–98th percentile linear stretch; round and clip to uint8. Same transform required at deployment.
statistics_fit: None. Deterministic image-only transform; labels and other images are not used.
source_values: Publisher-normalized spectral bands; not assumed to be raw reflectance or Sentinel-2 TCI.
deployment_note: Current map uses 224-pixel TCI crops. This checkpoint requires 128-pixel native crops and rgb_preprocessing.py. TCI clipping/atmospheric differences remain; validate before deployment.
